craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of fitted joinery — utsāha as qualifier meets qualified without loss. Prohibition hammer (let-it-touch-no…): touching brings knower-split — consequence in one breath. Rejected: (a) softening prohibition → killed: vyāpti needs the edge. (b) split→difference → killed: split enacts. Read aloud: ITS-bu-si-ness, BLOCKED by-THIS — … TOUCH-ing BRINGS know-er-SPLIT.

lines: let it touch no other thought: touching brings knower-split.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vyāpāro'nena ruddho'sau na vikalpāntaraṃ spṛśet vikalpāntarasaṃsparśe mātṛbhedaprasaṅgataḥ

reads_against.argmap: Does blocked activity touch another thought? → One reflection's business touches no other thought, or knowers multiply.
c1_essence: Unity without strain for the consciousness-bodied; the worldly one's reflection-object fixed as difference-pithed non-difference-shining (vv10-11).
Mechanics: one thought un-touched, one word uniting many, helping relation admitted, twoness in manyness, two facings, three thinkings, genitive settling unself-lost (vv12-18).
